title: LangGraph conditional edges
comment_samples: I'm lazy... any repo? I like this useful example of a conditional edge for a processing trigger for future actions... which i assume we'll see in your next video :)
description:
In LangGraph, we can use conditional edges in our flow engineering to control the flow based on some conditions. In this video, we use conditional edges to build a cycle and wait until a file is created in our source folder.

01:03 Install LangGraph and import Graph from langgraph.graph
01:38 Create functions representing LangGraph nodes
02:47 Create routing_function for LangGraph conditional edges
03:56 Create node for watch conditional route
04:38 Create node for process conditional route
06:41 Create a conditional edge in LangGraph graph
08:09 Use streaming functionality of LangGraph
